footnotes.text: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.000 cumulative GPA.

evidence.quote: 1. Regardless of individual course grades, students must maintain a minimum 2.000 cumulative GPA.

footnotes.text: 2. Some programs require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

evidence.quote: 2. Some programs require a minimum GPA for major courses. Courses indicated in this column are included in the major GPA for this program of study.

footnotes.text: 3. Students who do not place into MATH 122 or 141 will be required to take the required prerequisite before proceeding with MATH 122 or 141. The student’s choice of interdisciplinary studies path will determine which math course is applicable to the program of study.

evidence.quote: 3. Students who do not place into MATH 122 or 141 will be required to take the required prerequisite before proceeding with MATH 122 or 141. The student’s choice of interdisciplinary studies path will determine which math course is applicable to the program of study.

footnotes.text: 4. Students in the College of Arts and Sciences are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 122 course through course credit or the corresponding foreign language placement score.

evidence.quote: 4. Students in the College of Arts and Sciences are required to demonstrate proficiency in one foreign language equivalent to the 122 course through course credit or the corresponding foreign language placement score.

footnotes.text: 5. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students. Specific courses may be required to meet some Carolina Core requirements depending upon the interdisciplinary studies path chosen.

evidence.quote: 5. The Carolina Core provides the common core of knowledge, skill and academic experience for all Carolina undergraduate students. Specific courses may be required to meet some Carolina Core requirements depending upon the interdisciplinary studies path chosen.

footnotes.text: 6. Each student must complete a program of studies designed by an interdisciplinary program committee appointed by the College Academic Affairs and Advising Office. The program shall include a minimum of 36 semester hours of credit in major eligible courses in two or more fields. No course submitted in fulfillment of the general education requirements may be included in the program requirements. A maximum of 15 semester hours of independent study courses may be applied to the interdisciplinary studies program requirement.

evidence.quote: 6. Each student must complete a program of studies designed by an interdisciplinary program committee appointed by the College Academic Affairs and Advising Office. The program shall include a minimum of 36 semester hours of credit in major eligible courses in two or more fields. No course submitted in fulfillment of the general education requirements may be included in the program requirements. A maximum of 15 semester hours of independent study courses may be applied to the interdisciplinary studies program requirement.

footnotes.text: 7. The cognate is intended to support the course work in the major. The cognate must consist of twelve hours of courses at the advanced level, outside of, but related to the major. In place of a cognate, a student may choose a minor consisting of at least 18 credit hours of courses concentrated in one area that follow a structured sequence. A second major eliminates the minor/cognate requirement.

footnotes.text: 8. The College of Arts and Sciences requires one U.S. History and one non-U.S. History course, both of which must be chosen from the approved Carolina Core GHS courses. Whichever is not fulfilled through the Carolina Core GHS requirement must be fulfilled through this college requirement.

footnotes.text: 9. No courses of a remedial, developmental, skill-acquiring, or vocational nature may apply as credit toward degrees in the College of Arts and Sciences. The College of Arts and Sciences allows the use of the Pass-Fail option on elective courses. Further clarification on inapplicable courses can be obtained from the College of Arts and Sciences. The number of approved electives applicable to the program of study may depend upon the path chosen for the interdisciplinary studies major.
